file: 359 In This Roblox Game the Monster Can Hear the Water.mp4

lines.t: This new fun game on Roblox has one rule. Don't splash.

full.credit: Clips: BemmyBlock; Kubz Scouts (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

sc.big:
THIS NEW FUN
GAME ON ROBLOX

lines.t: You're stuck in the poolrooms. Endless tiled halls, full of water.

full.credit: Clips: BemmyBlock; Kubz Scouts (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: The monster is blind. But it can hear the water. Fall in, or land a jump badly, and it's coming for you.

full.credit: Clips: BemmyBlock; Kubz Scouts (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: It came out in October. It got over 160 million visits in its first 17 days.

full.credit: Clips: BemmyBlock; Kubz Scouts (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: Could you make it out without a splash?

full.credit: Clips: BemmyBlock; Kubz Scouts (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)
